items.new: "Listen again — the deeper layer. All visible things, man, are nothing but cardboard masks. But in each event — in the living act, the undeniable deed — there, some unknown but still reasoning thing puts forth the molded shape of its features from behind the unreasoning mask. If a man would strike, strike through the mask! How can the prisoner reach outside except by thrusting through the wall? To me, the white whale is that wall, shoved close against me. Sometimes I think there's nothing beyond it. But that's enough. He tasks me. He heaps me. I see in him outrageous strength, with an inscrutable malice giving it sinew. That inscrutable thing is chiefly what I hate. And whether the white whale is the agent or the principal, I will wreak that hate upon him. Don't talk to me of blasphemy, man — I'd strike the sun if it insulted me. For if the sun could do that, then I could do the other, since there is always a kind of fair play in this, with jealousy presiding over all creation. But not even that fair play is my master, man. Who is over me? Truth knows no boundaries. Take your eyes off me! More unbearable than a fiend's glare is a dull, stupid stare! So, so — you flush red and go pale. My heat has melted you into an angry glow. But listen, Starbuck — what is said in heat unsays itself. There are men from whom hot words are only a small indignity. I didn't mean to provoke you. Let it go. Look! See those Turkish cheeks of spotted tawny brown — living, breathing pictures painted by the sun. The pagan leopards — the heedless, unworshipping things that live and seek and give no reasons for the torrid life they feel! The crew, man, the crew! Aren't they one and all with Ahab in this matter of the whale? See Stubb — he laughs! See that Chilean — he snorts just thinking of it. Stand up against the general hurricane? Your one tossed sapling cannot, Starbuck! And what is it? Think about it. It's only helping to strike a fin — no great feat for Starbuck. What more is it? From this one poor hunt, then, the best lance out of all Nantucket will surely not hang back, when every common sailor has already grabbed a whetstone? Ah! Compulsions seize you — I see it! The wave lifts you! Speak — speak! Yes, yes! Your silence, then — that speaks for you. (Aside) Something shot from my flaring nostrils, and he has breathed it into his lungs. Starbuck is mine now. He cannot oppose me now without rebellion."

items.reason: Source "stripped of all direct associations calculated to impart to it aught fearful ... the same sorcery, however modified" and "would seem impossible". Candidate drops "direct" (the qualification the argument rests on), turns "calculated to" (apt to) into intentional "meant to", narrows "modified" to "softened", and drops the tentative "would".
items.new: But though this point is settled beyond dispute, how can any mortal account for it? To analyze it would seem impossible. Can we, then, by citing some of those cases where this thing of whiteness — though for the time mostly or entirely stripped of all direct associations that might lend it anything fearful — is nevertheless found to work the same spell on us, however modified, hope to stumble upon some clue that leads us to the hidden cause we seek?
